trigger_condition.state_trigger: TorchScript-traced model executed through PyTorch Mobile
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: TorchScript interpreter invokes boxed dispatch for aten::relu on Vulkan backend
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Backend: Vulkan; Execution: PyTorch Mobile; Model format: TorchScript; Operator: aten::relu

root_cause.kernel_layer: aten::relu KernelFunction for Vulkan is registered such that it can only be called via call(), not callBoxed(), causing an internal assertion during boxed dispatch.

bug_oracle.description: TorchScript interpreter fails with RuntimeError when executing aten::relu on Vulkan backend.
bug_oracle.signal: RuntimeError: false INTERNAL ASSERT FAILED at ATen/core/boxing/KernelFunction.cpp; Tried to call KernelFunction::callBoxed() on a KernelFunction that can only be called with KernelFunction::call().

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate variable-shaped float tensors as ReLU inputs while varying dimensions and values within valid ranges.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct TorchScript modules that contain torch.relu or torch.nn.ReLU.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Execute the same TorchScript model through PyTorch Mobile on CPU and Vulkan backends to expose backend-specific dispatch failures.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Trace or serialize model, load in PyTorch Mobile with Vulkan backend, then execute forward pass.
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Compare runtime behavior across backends and flag RuntimeError or internal assertion failures that occur on Vulkan but not on CPU.
